lines.sub: Koi bhi content likes aur comments ke liye mat banao...
...kyunki ye sirf ego boost karte hain, growth nahi.
Content sirf isliye banao ki ye dusre ko bheja jaye. Kyu?
Kyunki algorithm ka sabse bada signal sirf 'Shares' hai.
Aur iska sabse bada hack pata hai kya hai?
Apni audience ko aisa mauka do ki woh video bhej kar saamne wale ko playfully insult kar sake...
...jaise: 'Abe tu kitna dumb hai, tereko ye nahi pata!'
Toh asli sawaal jo aapko khud se poochna chahiye, woh ye hai...
